biocs.name: SSH Brute Force Process Execution
biocs.description: Detection of hydra process execution attempting SSH login
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = '/tmp/ssh_brute/hydra'

abiocs.name: SSH Authentication Brute Force Attempts
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation from normal SSH login patterns detected by ML
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = '/tmp/ssh_brute/hydra'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter dst_port = 22

xql_queries.name: SSH Brute Force Hunt Query
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = '/tmp/ssh_brute/hydra'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter dst_port = 22
